frozen: 2026-11-01, before any result of this search; after the screens of e65 (band snow), e67 (continental sea air), e68 (baroclinic storm track) and e69 (sunshine-driven wet-ground cooling) on dev31 (reports/SEASON_PHASE_20261031.md sections 3-7; output/season_phase_20261031, output/continental_sea_20261031, output/storm_baroclinic_20261101, output/wet_sun_20261101) and the failed land-ice refit (calibration/land_ice_refit_20261031: dev31 0.9843 with training 1.0029 through East China; sealed set b unseen).
why: Each new lever mends one group and breaks another: e65 the maritime mid-latitudes (Pacific NW, Alps, eastern Europe), e68 counted on cool air Iberia, Manchuria, the Great Basin and the British Isles (S 0.9950), e69 with less of the annual-mean wet cooling East China (2.00 -> 1.30 C), North India and the US Midwest. Their failures are in different places, so the search balances them together, starting from the land-ice refit's best candidate.
